The divide-by-zero finding is fixed. The new `first` function panics when `n > len`, unlike `last`, which uses `saturating_sub`. The sum can also overflow i32, but that was already there, so I'm not raising it.

draftedFindings.title: `first` panics when n exceeds the slice length
draftedFindings.body: `&items[..n]` panics if `n > items.len()`. The sibling `last` clamps with `saturating_sub`, so callers will expect `first` to be safe too. Clamp instead: `&items[..n.min(items.len())]`. Also add tests for n = 0, n > len and an empty slice.
